exceptions.reason: Build-time only: expo 58 -> @expo/config (58.0.9, the latest release, which still depends on deepmerge ^4.3.1) merges the mobile app's own config with the modifications of its config plugins (Config.js, getConfigFilePaths and plugin props), on the developer's machine, from files this repository owns. The prototype poisoning needs a malicious source object in mergeObject(); nothing here passes input from outside the repository to it, and nothing of it ships in the mobile app. deepmerge 4.3.1 is the latest release and the advisory lists no patched version.

Build-time only: @electron/universal -> @electron/asar 3.4.1 uses minimatch 3.1.5's callable CommonJS API. The advisory's broad <11.0.1 range includes this copy, but its firstPhasePreProcess/optimizationLevel pipeline does not exist in 3.x; upstream's changelog dates that preprocessing to 7.0. This copy cannot execute the vulnerable globparts amplification. Forcing 11.x removes the callable export and breaks archive unpack matching. Modern minimatch and glob copies are upgraded separately.

Build-time only: app-builder-lib -> @electron/asar 3.4.1 uses minimatch 3.1.5's callable CommonJS API. This copy has no firstPhasePreProcess or optimizationLevel pipeline, introduced upstream in 7.0, so the globparts amplification cannot run despite the advisory's broad <11.0.1 range. Replacing it with 11.x breaks archive unpack matching because the callable export was removed. Modern minimatch and glob copies are upgraded separately.

Build-time only: dir-compare 4.2.0 requires minimatch 3.1.5's callable CommonJS API. This copy has no firstPhasePreProcess or optimizationLevel pipeline, introduced upstream in 7.0, so the globparts amplification cannot run despite the advisory's broad <11.0.1 range. Forcing 11.x removes that callable export and breaks directory filters. Modern minimatch and glob copies are upgraded separately.

This copy has no firstPhasePreProcess or optimizationLevel pipeline, introduced upstream in 7.0, so the globparts amplification cannot run despite the advisory's broad <11.0.1 range. Build-time only: filelist 1.0.6 -> minimatch 5.1.9 uses the callable CommonJS export and Minimatch.makeRe(). This copy has no firstPhasePreProcess or optimizationLevel pipeline, introduced upstream in 7.0, so the globparts amplification cannot run despite the advisory's broad <11.0.1 range. Both legacy APIs are absent from 11.x, which would break build file selection. Modern minimatch and glob copies are upgraded separately.

Build-time only: legacy glob 7.2.3, used by rimraf and the older @electron/asar copies, needs minimatch 3.1.5's Minimatch.matchOne(), makeRe(), and RegExp set entries. This copy has no firstPhasePreProcess or optimizationLevel pipeline, introduced upstream in 7.0, so the globparts amplification cannot run despite the advisory's broad <11.0.1 range. Forcing 11.x removes the APIs glob 7 requires. Modern glob copies use patched minimatch 11 instead.

The memory exhaustion is in zod 4's array parsing ($ZodArray, handleArrayResult in zod/v4/core), which this copy (3.25.76) has only under its zod/v4 subpath; the advisory marks it because the 3.x line has no patched release. @cursor/sdk 1.0.34 imports the v3 API from "zod", whose implementation (zod/v3) has no such code. The desktop app's own schemas use the patched zod 4.6.7. @cursor/sdk is pinned at 1.0.34 and bundles its own copy of zod/v4/mini inside its dist, which no dependency update changes; 1.0.38 and later take zod as a peer dependency, so a later SDK bump removes this copy.

Build-time only: expo 58 -> @expo/cli, the development server and bundler CLI of the mobile app, which is not shipped in it. The memory exhaustion is in zod 4's array parsing ($ZodArray, handleArrayResult in zod/v4/core); this copy (3.25.76) is used through the v3 API (require("zod")), whose implementation has no such code, and the advisory marks it because the 3.x line has no patched release. It validates DevTools plugin and MCP extension descriptions (DevToolsPlugin.schema, createMCPDevToolsExtensionSchema) on the developer's machine. @expo/cli 58.1.14, the latest release, still depends on zod ^3.25.76.
